Definition: from G813; to be (i.e. act) irregular:--behave self disorderly.
BiblicalUsage: Paul reminds the Thessalonians that he did not behave disorderly among them, working night and day so as not to be a burden. The word means to break ranks, like a soldier out of step.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that order in the church is not about rules for their own sake, it is about love that refuses to be a burden on others.
